verdict.rationale: Fireflies ships its own AI assistant (AskFred/Fred), so asking whether it can consume external MCP servers is a fair question for this product. However, the evidence only documents Fireflies acting as an MCP server: its own MCP server and a Docs MCP server that expose Fireflies data and tools to outside AI tools. Nothing shows Fireflies connecting to third-party MCP servers or using their tools, and server-side MCP evidence does not count toward this client-side story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
